operations.atomicity: safe observation reads a bounded current-head projection only after resolving the exact current owner-issued read verifier and never mutates service custody
operations.replay: same head and observation receipt replay; changed head, expired, revoked, foreign, or cross-family read authority returns no disclosure

operations.atomicity: canonical package, exact predecessor lineage, capability intersection, job identity, and event append commit atomically
operations.replay: exact principal/project/task/package replay returns the original job receipt; changed bytes or any capability/lineage revision conflicts with no write

operations.atomicity: read-only safe projection returns optional job, attempt, decision, disposition, and subscription observations only after resolving the exact current owner-issued read verifier
operations.replay: same current projection replays; changed head, expired, revoked, foreign, or cross-family read authority denies without disclosure

operations.atomicity: one bounded service-owned attempt allocation/start follows the admitted package and job without provider dispatch authority
operations.replay: same job/attempt ordinal replay returns existing custody; changed package, policy, or terminality rejects

operations.atomicity: decision records only the exact predecessor advisory lineage and visible attempt outcome
operations.replay: same attempt and predecessor digest replay; changed source or terminal winner conflicts

operations.atomicity: complete package/job/attempt/decision and predecessor lineage population seals one advisory disposition
operations.replay: same complete population replay returns original disposition; omitted/extra/changed member blocks sealing

operations.atomicity: owner-issued submit verifier is checked for exact project/task/principal/scope/time/budget
operations.replay: same verifier revision replays; changed operation or scope cannot be rebound

operations.atomicity: owner-issued read verifier is checked for exact job/projection/principal/scope/time/budget
operations.replay: same verifier revision replays; submit, subscribe, acknowledge, or wake use is rejected

operations.atomicity: owner-issued subscribe/ack verifier is checked for exact subscription/job/projection/principal/scope/time/budget
operations.replay: same verifier revision replays; read, submit, or wake use is rejected

operations.atomicity: owner-issued wake verifier is checked for exact task/job/contract/principal/scope/time/budget
operations.replay: same verifier revision replays; submit, read, subscribe, or acknowledge use is rejected

operations.atomicity: subscription, initial acknowledged cursor, exact filter/projection, adapter, and capability revisions publish atomically
operations.replay: same exact subscription tuple replays; changed scope, projection, adapter, or capability conflicts

operations.atomicity: each offer/replay reauthorizes the exact subscription and emits an immutable contiguous outbox offer
operations.replay: unacknowledged or expired offer replays from acknowledged cursor; historical offer and acknowledged cursor are not rewritten

operations.atomicity: exact bound acknowledgment and contiguous cursor CAS commit together after capability reauthorization
operations.replay: exact acknowledgment replay is idempotent; changed digest/sequence/principal or gap has no cursor effect

operations.atomicity: registered wakeup carries bounded package/disposition/artifact lineage and fresh wake capability receipt
operations.replay: same task/job/attempt/projection replay is idempotent; wake cannot acknowledge or advance delivery cursor

operations.atomicity: cancellation is prospective and exact-CAS fenced; unknown/running terminality is never guessed
operations.replay: same prestart cancellation replays; acknowledged running or terminal attempt cannot be relabeled

operations.atomicity: expiry/revocation records a typed pause or invalidation and never swaps authority into an existing subscription
operations.replay: same authority transition replays; a new revision is required before disclosure resumes

operations.atomicity: authenticated event/custody verification and complete population equality precede recovery readiness
operations.replay: same ledger head/source population replays; relabel, gap, orphan, fork, stale, or digest mismatch blocks with no new attempt/disclosure

semantic_laws.slice: optional daemon observation -> WorkThread canonical AuditPackage -> exact DSS-0.5 advisory/artifact lineage -> durable AuditJob/attempt/decision/disposition -> separately authorized delivery offer/acknowledgment/cursor -> bounded task wakeup
semantic_laws.identity: service-owned external identity is the intersection of exact project/task/workThread/principal/capability/revision and canonical package digest; caller-self-constituted owner/root/authorized objects, labels, paths, UI state, and peer identity never prove it

semantic_laws.custody: package, job, attempt, decision, disposition, subscription, offer, acknowledgment, cursor, wakeup, and recovery records are durable publish-before-reference records with exact source/revision/custody digests
semantic_laws.currentness: every mutation and every disclosure checks exact current revision, project/task/job scope, principal, capability family, expiry, revocation epoch, time fence, and budget; reauthorization occurs before each offer/replay/acknowledgment/wakeup
semantic_laws.capabilitySeparation: submit_audit_package, read_audit_disposition, subscribe_disposition_ack, and wake_task are distinct operation capabilities with no cross-use
semantic_laws.package: canonical AuditPackage binds exact WorkThread-origin identity and full DSS-0.5 advisory/artifact lineage; submitting task may terminate without execution custody
semantic_laws.observation: daemon health, jobs, attempts, decisions, and subscriptions are optional bounded safe projections; every observation operation consumes the exact current owner-issued d.read-capability for principal/project/task/job/projection/revision/expiry/revocation/time/budget, and invalid authority yields no disclosure or effect
semantic_laws.delivery: offers advance derived offered position only; exact contiguous acknowledgment advances durable acknowledged cursor; unacknowledged/expired offers replay from acknowledged cursor with a fresh authorization receipt
semantic_laws.wakeup: task wakeup consumes the durable outbox with a separate capability and registered continuation contract; it is at-least-once/idempotent and cannot acknowledge or advance the delivery cursor
semantic_laws.replaceability: Electron and CLI are replaceable adapters; absence, closure, restart, or delayed subscriber recovery cannot change job/package/disposition/artifact identity or delivery standing
semantic_laws.recovery: recovery recomputes status, reason, source digest, authority effect, revisions, and complete package/disposition/delivery/wakeup populations; unequal or missing source blocks with no new attempt, disclosure, cursor advance, or authority effect
semantic_laws.effects: advisory only; no project/WorldManager/provider/runtime/credential/repository/filesystem/tool/network/UI/institutional mutation or authority grant
semantic_laws.exclusions: no provider/network/credentials, repository/filesystem/tool access, project/WorldManager mutation, authority bridge, production commissioning/activation, or DSS-0.7 tranche
semantic_laws.invalidEvidence: generic PASS, self-attestation, fabricated receipts, labels-as-tests, unreachable fixtures, regex polarity, cross-carrier laundering, inline capability/evidence bypass, and incomplete population accounting are not proof

predecessor.acceptance: field-for-field package binding to exact DSS-0.5 advisory/artifact lineage; mismatch is PREDECESSOR_MISMATCH with no effect
